chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: How instruments shape the sound; the Fender bass
summary: DeMichael argues old instruments create the sound of the 1920s and 30s and rock needed the Fender bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I'd love to get an old vibraphone.
It was a different sound. Same way with the drums.
Nobody's ever gone in to how the development of musical instruments has affected the music.
For instance, there would be no rock and roll without the development of the Fender bass.
That's the basis of it all.
You couldn't do that on an a-coustic.
So that changed the course of music.
